narratives.Description: rfc(harness): classify launcher-family CLI argv as process-only skip; dest-absent fail-closed
narratives.Overview: Spec is Bound remedy lean 5654184215 plus operator recut, not original Slice B implement spawn-class. Classify launcher-family worker argv (grok/claude/codex) ahead of the shell branch. Dest-absent fail-closed (#4066). Dest-present linked dest is argv-reachable process-only skip. Do not classify grok --cwd as implement spawn. Do not implement sibling #4315. Drop unenforceable envelope-only-until-#4219 from GROK_CRITIC_SPAWN_NOT_READY_RECOVERY. Native first; CLI last-resort after recorded native miss. Full thread: https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4219
narratives.AcceptanceCriteria:
- Classify launcher-family worker argv (grok/claude/codex), not one named form. Dest-absent fail-closed (#4066).
- Argv-reachable process-only skip lands in the same change. Same-posture-as-implement spawn-class cannot bind alone.
- New argv classification ahead of the shell branch. Do not host this on shellDestForms or SPAWN_TOOL_NAMES.
- Convert shell-op-unclassifiable fail-open to a classified decision. Include read-only-deny.
- Predicate makes dest-present launcher argv process-only skip checkable; drop unenforceable envelope-only-until-#4219 from GROK_CRITIC_SPAWN_NOT_READY_RECOVERY.
- Native first; CLI last-resort after recorded native miss. Do not dual-launch.
- Do not implement sibling #4315 native spawn schema product.
- CHANGELOG.
